query: /* postgres */ update t_repository set url = $1, branch = $2, sub_path = $3, name = $4, scan_interval_minutes = $5, scan_cron = $6, scan_manual_only = $7, required_agent_label = $8, last_scheduled_scan_at = $9, ssh_key_id = $10, https_token_id = $11, badge_token = $12, tier = $13, in_certified_scope = $14, url_identity = $15, identity_guard = $16 where id = $17
